evidence: Film thicknesses were determined in a routine manner with energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) using a Link ISIS EDX spectrometer installed to a Zeiss DSM 962 scanning electron microscope (SEM) and a GMRFILM program. Accuracies of the film thicknesses measured by EDX were verified with Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (RBS) using a 2.0 MeV 4He beam. Film crystallinity was examined with a Philips MPD 1880 powder X-ray diffractometer (XRD). Film surfaces and their fractured cross sections were viewed with a Hitachi S-4500 field emission scanning electron microscope (FE-SEM). Film resistivities were measured with a standard four-point probe method. The film growth was examined with scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Atomic force microscopy (AFM) studies were used to investigate the film morphology.
